test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which scheme of the Government of India provides for the delivery of LPG cylinders to the below poverty line (BPL) families?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Ujjwala__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana** is a scheme run by **the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas** that aims to link women from BPL households to LPG.
 
• On **May 1, 2016**, the initiative was introduced in **Ballia, Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• The scheme's goal was to provide **8 million LPG connections** to low-income families by March 2020.
 
• Provision has been included in the Union Budget for FY 21-22 for the release of an additional 1 crore LPG connections under the PMUY scheme.
 
• Migrant families have been given particular treatment throughout this era.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **LPG cylinders** have been widely distributed in urban and semi-urban regions, with coverage primarily among the middle and upper classes.
 
• Cooking using fossil fuels, on the other hand, has substantial health risks. According to WHO estimates, dirty cooking fuels are responsible for nearly 5 lakh deaths in India alone.
 
• Providing LPG connections to BPL families will ensure that everyone in the country has access to cooking gas.
 
• Women will be empowered and their health will be protected as a result of this measure. It will cut down on drudgery and cooking time. It will also generate jobs for rural kids in the cooking gas supply chain.
